name: matrixflow-ai
description: MatrixFlow AI — AI 员工操作系统（跨境电商 AI 运营团队 SaaS 平台）

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/web build
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/shared lint && corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/web lint
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/shared typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/web typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @matrixflow/shared test && node --test scripts/production-smoke.test.mjs scripts/production-config-audit.test.mjs scripts/appwrite-schema-check.test.mjs scripts/i18n-key-audit.test.mjs
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm schema:check && corepack pnpm i18n:check && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
